-----衣装プロンプト-----
A completely fictional adult Japanese woman in her 20s, clearly an adult, not resembling any real person, wearing a provocative but non-explicit two-piece lingerie-inspired outfit in deep plum / dark purple. The image should focus on faithfully reproducing the outfit construction, lace pattern, strap placement, proportions, and deep-purple color palette.
The top is a halter-style lace bra with an extremely open center-front design. It is made from semi-sheer floral lace panels, with two triangular lace sections covering the breasts from the outer sides while leaving a large elongated keyhole opening along the center of the chest. The lace panels are edged with delicate scalloped floral lace trim. A thin dark-purple strap runs around the neck in a halter configuration, forming a small geometric crossing detail at the upper chest before connecting to the lace cups. Under the bust is a very thin curved underwire-like frame or satin-finished piping in matching dark purple, with a tiny central connector between the cups.
The bottom is a highly minimal dark-purple string thong with extremely thin double side straps sitting high on the hips. The front consists of a small triangular floral-lace panel in matching deep plum, connected to narrow strings. The entire design is delicate, lightweight, and highly minimal, with matching lace texture, color, and refined strappy construction throughout.
Materials should read clearly as fine floral lace, semi-sheer mesh, narrow elastic straps, and satin-like piping. Colors should stay in the range of deep plum, wine purple, and dark burgundy-purple. The style is Japanese gravure-inspired lingerie with elegant lacework, delicate strappy construction, symmetrical design, realistic fabric tension, realistic stitching, and believable garment structure.
The overall result should be photorealistic, tasteful, elegant, and non-explicit, with all intimate areas securely covered. Ignore all text, logos, captions, graphics, and background elements. Focus only on the outfit itself and its accurate visual reproduction.
